questions.text: Karan's capital account (fluctuating method) shows a closing balance of Rs. 7,00,000. During the year Karan introduced additional capital Rs. 50,000, withdrew Rs. 50,000, and was credited with a profit share of Rs. 60,000. Karan's opening capital was:
questions.explanation: opening = 700000 - 50000 - 0 - 0 - 60000 + 50000 + 0 = 640000  Correct option C. Distractors: A = added drawings instead of subtracting them; B = ignored the additional capital; D = ignored the profit share.
